info.title: Apollia OS Runtime API
info.description: Host driving contract for the Apollia OS sovereign agent runtime. Stable under /api/v1; breaking changes ship under /api/v2.

get.description:
Returns all agents with `supports_a2a = true` in active or degraded state,
along with their declared skills.

post.description:
Resolves `skill_id` to an active Worker Agent, submits the task, waits for
completion (with timeout), and returns the structured result.

Invokes a Worker Agent by skill ID via the [`A2AInvoker`].
Returns 503 if the invoker is not initialized.
Returns 404 if the skill is not found, 503 if the agent is not active.

503.description: A2A invoker not initialized or agent not active

get.description:
Returns the flat list of all available A2A skills via the [`A2AInvoker`].
Returns 503 if the invoker is not initialized.

Lists registered agents. When `?supports_a2a=true` is present, only agents
that declare `supports_a2a = true` in their manifest are returned, and each
entry includes the agent's `skills` and `version`.

parameters.name: supports_a2a
parameters.description: Restrict to agents declaring supports_a2a = true

post.description:
Loads the Python agent module via [`AgentLoader`], validates
AIP duck typing, registers the agent with its real manifest, transitions
to Active (or Degraded if optional tools are missing), and creates an
[`ExecutionCoordinator`] registered with the [`TaskRouter`].

Tool resolution is delegated to [`apollia_tools::resolve`] which handles
the `a2a:` prefix correctly (A2A dependencies live in the ToolProxy
allowed_tools list, not in the ToolRegistry, and must not trigger
DEGRADED). A missing `tools_required` entry returns 400 Bad Request.

Returns 201 Created with the agent_id and state.
Returns 400 Bad Request if the Python module is invalid.

get.description:
Returns the detail of a single agent including its manifest.
Accepts both a UUID and a human-readable agent name (e.g. `apollia-reviewer`).
Returns 404 if the agent does not exist.

delete.description:
Performs a full graceful shutdown of the agent:
1. Transitions to `Stopping` (emits `AgentStopping` event for observers).
2. Unregisters the `ExecutionCoordinator` from the `TaskRouter` so no new
   tasks can be submitted to this agent.
3. Transitions to `Stopped` (emits `AgentStopped` event).

This mirrors the sequence performed by [`ShutdownController::stop_agents`]
during full system shutdown. The `Stopping` intermediate state is preserved
so that event-bus subscribers (dashboard, SSE streams) observe the correct
lifecycle.

Accepts both a UUID and a human-readable agent name (e.g. `apollia-reviewer`).
Returns 409 Conflict if the agent is already stopped or stopping.
Returns 404 if the agent does not exist.

get.description:
Returns messages from the in-memory mailbox, sorted by `sent_at` descending.
Returns an empty array when the agent has no messages.
Returns `503` when the mailbox is not available.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/agents/:name/messages`, inject a message from the host.
post.description:
The host deposits a message into an agent's durable inbox. The recipient is
validated against the registry (`404` if unknown). A synthetic host-scoped
`run_id` is allocated so the injected message is journaled like any other.
Returns `503` when the mailbox is not available.

get.description:
Returns all tasks currently waiting for human approval, enriched with
prompt and context from `TaskRepository`.

Returns the last `limit` resolved approvals (approved or rejected)
within the last `days` days.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of resolved approvals to return (default 20)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 20, capped at 500)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of events to skip, most recent first (default 0). Page through the trail by advancing it.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/audit/anchor`, the exportable head anchor of the global chain.
get.description:
Storing this off-machine is the only defense against truncation of the
global tail once the signing key can be compromised. Returns 404 when the
journal has no entries yet, 503 when the journal is not configured.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/audit/journal?limit=N&offset=M`, a page of the chained journal
across every run.
get.description:
This is the only read of the journal that does not need a run id up front:
`GET /api/v1/audit/journal/{run_id}` answers a run the caller already knows,
and `GET /api/v1/audit` answers the separate tool-invocation trail. 503 when
the journal is not configured.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 20, capped at 500)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of entries to skip, newest first (default 0). Page through the journal by advancing it.

200.description: A page of hash-chained journal entries

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/audit/journal/:run_id`, the full journal for a run.
get.description:
Unlike `GET /api/v1/audit` (the tool-only audit trail), this returns the
hash-chained journal entries including `llm_completion` (the model's
prompts/responses). 404 when the run has no entries, 503 when the journal is
not configured.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Run id whose journal entries are returned

200.description: Full hash-chained journal for the run

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/audit/replay/:run_id`, replay a captured run and report
determinism.
post.description:
Resolves the run id (full or unambiguous prefix), runs the
[`ReplayHarness`], and returns a JSON body with a `status` discriminant:
`identical`, `diverged`, or `error`. Status codes: 200 for identical and
diverged (the determinism verdict is in the body), 404 for an unknown run,
400 for an ambiguous prefix, 422 for an incomplete trace, 503 when the
journal is not configured.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Run id (full or unambiguous prefix) to replay

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/audit/stats`, aggregate counts for the audit trail.
`GET /api/v1/audit/verify`, verify the whole journal across all runs.
get.description:
Unlike the per-run route, this walks the global chain (detecting interior
deletion and whole-run deletion) and compares the terminal head to the
persisted anchor (detecting global-tail truncation). An empty journal is a
valid 200 `ok:true`, not a 404. Returns 503 when the journal is not
configured and 500 on an internal error.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/audit/verify/:run_id`, verify a run's hash chain and signatures.
get.description:
Returns 200 with the [`VerifyChainReport`] (whether or not the chain is
intact), 404 when the run has no entries, 503 when the journal is not
configured, and 500 on an internal error.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Run id whose hash chain is verified

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/hooks`, list every registered lifecycle hook handler.
get.description: The response is a JSON array of [`HookHandlerSummary`] in declaration order.

200.description: Registered lifecycle hook handlers in declaration order

get.description:
Lists all configured backends from `system.db`.
Returns 503 if the repository is not available.

post.description:
Creates a new backend. Returns 201 on success, 409 if a default already exists
when `is_default` is set, 422 on validation error.

get.description: Returns the backend with the given name or 404 if not found.

put.description: Replaces an existing backend configuration. Returns 404 if the backend does not exist.

delete.description: Deletes a backend. Returns 409 if the backend is the current default, 404 if not found.

post.description: Marks the given backend as the default. Returns 404 if not found.

Builds a single-turn `CompletionRequest` from the prompt and dispatches it
via `LlmRouter::complete_with_observability`. Observability events
(`LlmCallCompleted`) are emitted on the `EventBus` automatically.

Returns `503 Service Unavailable` if no router is configured or the call fails.

503.description: No router configured or backend call failed

post.description:
Accepts a multi-turn conversation history and dispatches it through
`LlmRouter::complete_with_observability`. Each `MessageDto` is mapped
to a `ChatMessage` based on its `role` field:

- `"system"`    → `ChatMessage::system`
- `"user"`      → `ChatMessage::user`
- `"assistant"` → `ChatMessage::assistant`
- `"tool"`      → `ChatMessage::tool_result` (empty call id)

Returns `400 Bad Request` when an unknown role is encountered.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when no router is configured or the call fails.

503.description: No router configured or backend call failed

get.description:
Aggregates LLM call costs and token usage from `llm_calls.db` over the
requested time window. Returns 503 if no `LlmCallRepository` is available.

200.description: Aggregated LLM costs by backend and model

get.description:
Returns LLM costs broken down by day and backend for the requested
time window. Used by the Observability LLM Costs chart.

Both the day of each entry and the bounds of the window are the host's
local calendar, not UTC: `days` counts calendar days ending today, and the
window opens at local midnight of the first of them. A window measured in
24-hour slices from `now` reaches into a day the chart draws no bar for,
and the spend of that fraction then shows in a total no bar carries.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of local calendar days to aggregate, ending today (default 7)

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/llm/hardware`, detect and return the hardware profile.

post.description:
Sends a trivial completion request (`"ping"`) to the specified backend (or the
router default) and measures the round-trip latency.

Returns `503 Service Unavailable` with `available: false` when:
- No `LlmRouter` is configured, or
- The backend call fails (key missing, network error, etc.).

503.description: Backend unavailable or no router configured

200.description: Model metadata and file list (HuggingFace model card)

post.description:
Rebuilds the active `LlmRouter` from `system.db` and swaps it into the
shared cell exposed by [`AppState::llm_router`], without restarting the
daemon. The new router becomes visible to every subsequent reader
(`ping`, `chat`, `complete`, `status`); in-flight requests that already
hold a snapshot of the previous router finish against the old router and
are not interrupted.

The route also forwards the freshly-built router to the
[`ChatSessionManager`] via its `ReloadLlm` actor command so live chat
sessions pick up the new model on their next turn.

Returns:
- `200 OK` with the list of backends now active.
- `503 Service Unavailable` when `llm_backend_repo` is `None` (the runtime
  was started without `system.db`, typically a unit test).
- `500 Internal Server Error` when the repository is reachable but
  building the router fails (invalid config_json, model file missing for
  a local backend, etc.).

200.description: Router reloaded with the live backend list

503.description: Backend repository unavailable or no default backend

get.description:
Returns the list of all configured backends with their availability state.
Returns `{"backends": []}` if no `LlmRouter` is configured in `AppState`.

200.description: Configured LLM backends and cost headroom

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/mailbox/stream`, observe all mailbox traffic as SSE.
get.description:
Streams every mailbox event (sent, delivered, acked, dropped, guard) so the
host can watch inter-agent messaging live. The stream stays open until the
client disconnects.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/mcp/resources`, List MCP resources aggregated across servers.
get.description:
Returns the same data as the agent-facing `mcp_resources_list` tool: one
entry per resource exposed by a connected MCP server, tagged with its owning
server. Feeds the desktop @-mention picker.

Returns an empty array (not an error) when no MCP configuration is active,
so the picker degrades to "no resources" rather than a failure state.

200.description: MCP resources aggregated across connected servers

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/mcp/servers`, List all connected MCP servers with their status.
get.description: Returns an empty array when no MCP configuration is active.

200.description: Connected MCP servers with their status

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/mcp/servers`, Add a new MCP server and persist it to `mcp.db`.
post.description:
Spawns the server process and registers its tools, then saves the configuration.
Returns `201 Created` with the server status on success.
Returns `409 Conflict` when a server with the same name is already managed.
Returns `400 Bad Request` for invalid configurations or spawn failures.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when MCP is not configured.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/mcp/servers/test`, Test a server configuration without persisting a session.
post.description:
Spawns an ephemeral process, performs the MCP initialize handshake and `tools/list`,
captures the result, then immediately terminates the process. No session is stored
and the tool registry is not modified.

Response shape:
- `200 {"kind":"success", …}`, handshake succeeded, tools listed.
- `200 {"kind":"oauth_required", "www_authenticate":"…"}`, server returned
  401, the desktop should drive the MCP HTTP OAuth flow before retrying.
- `400 Bad Request`, other handshake failures (transport, JSON-RPC error,
  timeout, etc.).

200.description: Handshake succeeded, or OAuth is required (see kind field)

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/mcp/servers/:name`, Get detailed info for a specific MCP server.
get.description:
Returns `404 Not Found` when no server with the given name is connected.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when MCP is not configured.

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v1/mcp/servers/:name`, Remove an MCP server and delete it from `mcp.db`.
delete.description:
Shuts down the session, unregisters the server, then removes its database entry.
Returns `200 OK` with `{"removed": "<name>"}` on success.
Returns `404 Not Found` when no server with the given name is managed.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when MCP is not configured.

patch.summary: `PATCH /api/v1/mcp/servers/:name/approval`, Update the approval flag without restarting.
patch.description:
Updates the `requires_approval` flag in-memory and persists the change to `mcp.db`.
The running session is **not** restarted; the new flag takes effect for the next
tool call. Returns `200 OK` with the updated [`McpServerStatus`] on success.
Returns `404 Not Found` when no server with `name` is managed.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when MCP is not configured.

put.summary: `PUT /api/v1/mcp/servers/:name/config`, Replace a server configuration and restart the session.
put.description:
Removes the current session, starts a new one with the updated configuration, then
upserts the entry in `mcp.db`.
Returns `200 OK` with the new [`McpServerStatus`] on success.
Returns `404 Not Found` when no server with `name` is managed.
Returns `400 Bad Request` when the new session fails to start.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when MCP is not configured.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/mcp/servers/:name/raw_config`, Return the persisted launch
configuration of a server (command, args, env, transport, …) as stored in
`mcp.db`.
get.description:
The `env` map contains either literal values for non-secret variables or
`${APOLLIA_SECRET:NAME}` placeholders for secret ones, actual secret
material is never returned. Used by the desktop "Modifier les arguments"
flow to fetch the current config, patch `args`, and PUT the result back
without losing the rest of the configuration.

Returns `404 Not Found` when no server with `name` is persisted.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when the MCP repository is unavailable.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/mcp/servers/:name/restart`, Restart a specific MCP server session.
post.description:
Restarts an existing session or first-time-connects one declared in `mcp.db`.

Stops the current session and spawns a new one using the original
configuration. When the server was declared in `mcp.db` but never
connected (e.g. the previous start was blocked by a missing OAuth token,
later supplied via `apollia-os mcp oauth login`), we fall back to a
fresh `add_server` call using the persisted config, making this route
the single "(re)connect this server now" endpoint operators need.
Returns `404 Not Found` when the name is unknown to both the manager
and the repository.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when MCP is not configured.

Re-handshakes the live session for reachability, then runs the optional
read-only probe to exercise real operational access (scopes, grants). The
response `result.live_health` carries the operational verdict, so the
desktop can distinguish "reachable" from "actually working".

Response shape mirrors [`test_connection`]: `success` (with `live_health`),
`oauth_required`, or `400`.

200.description: Live handshake and probe result, or OAuth required (see kind field)

get.description:
Reads from the SQLite repository. Falls back to `notification_config`
if the repo is not available.

post.description:
Validates the channel, inserts it into `notifications.db`, then reloads the
[`NotificationEngine`] via its handle.

put.description:
Updates the channel in `notifications.db`, then reloads the
[`NotificationEngine`].

delete.description:
Deletes the channel from `notifications.db`, then reloads the
[`NotificationEngine`].

put.description:
Validates each event against the known event set (`KNOWN_EVENTS`),
then replaces the list in `notifications.db` and reloads the
notification engine.

get.description:
Reads from `notifications.db` via the repository.
Falls back to `hitl.db` if the repo is not available (backward compat).

post.description:
For each channel enabled in the config:
- Instantiates the channel via [`build_channels`]
- Sends a test [`Notification`] with the `"test.ping"` event
- Measures latency and collects the status (`"ok"`, `"error"`, `"disabled"`)

Source of truth: the channel list is read from the SQLite repository, not
from the `state.notification_config` snapshot (which is frozen at boot and
does not reflect CRUD performed via the API). Falling back to the snapshot
when the repo is unavailable preserves the legacy behavior for
`apollia.toml`-only config.

Returns the number of entries that were removed. Returns `503` when
the plan cache repository is not configured.

get.description:
Returns zeroed counters when the cache is empty. Returns `503` when
the plan cache repository is not configured.

404.description: No recorded circuit breaker for the tool

200.description: Snapshot of every registered circuit breaker
Circuit breaker snapshot for the tool

404.description: No recorded circuit breaker for the tool

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by session status: active, processing, closed

post.summary: Handler for `POST /api/v1/sessions`, create a new chat session.

get.summary: Handler for `GET /api/v1/sessions/recent`, list recent sessions with first message.
get.description: Query param `?limit=N` (default 10, max 50).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum sessions to return (default 10, capped at 50)

get.summary: Handler for `GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/children`, list fork children of a session.
get.description: Returns a JSON array of [`SessionInfo`] objects, ordered by creation time ascending.

post.description:
Creates a new child session that copies the parent history up to `up_to_index`
messages. When `up_to_index` is omitted, the full history is copied.
Returns the new child [`SessionInfo`] with HTTP 201.

post.summary: Handler for `POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/resume`, resume an existing session.
post.description:
Loads the session from SQLite if not already in memory, resets any stale
Processing status to Active, and returns the full session detail.

get.description:
Opens a persistent SSE stream filtering `ChatXxx` [`RuntimeEvent`]s by `session_id`.
The stream closes when `ChatSessionClosed` is emitted.

get.summary: Handler for `GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/todo`, read the session todo list.
get.description:
Returns 200 with the items (an empty array when the session exists but has
no todo), and 404 when the session is unknown to the runtime.

post.description:
Emits [`RuntimeEvent::ShutdownRequested`] on the EventBus. The caller
(typically `apollia-os start`) listens for this event to trigger
graceful shutdown.

get.description:
Returns `200 OK` with the current [`SttConfigRow`] from `system.db`.
If the table is empty (first boot), the defaults are inserted and returned.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when the config repository is unavailable.

put.description:
Accepts a JSON body of [`SttConfigRow`] (fields with `#[serde(default)]` may
be omitted, missing fields receive their default values). Replaces the
singleton row in `system.db` via an upsert.

Returns `200 OK` with the updated configuration.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when the config repository is unavailable.

requestBody.description: Updated STT configuration (SttConfigRow); fields with defaults may be omitted

get.description:
Scans `~/.apollia/models/` for `.bin` files and returns their name,
path, and size. Returns an empty list if the directory does not exist.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/stt/reload`, rebuild the STT engine from persisted config.
post.description:
Reads the current `stt_config` row from `system.db`, rebuilds the engine
actor via [`build_stt_engine`](crate::stt::build_stt_engine), swaps it into
the shared cell, and shuts the previous engine down. Lets a model enabled or
downloaded mid-session come online without restarting the daemon. Idempotent:
swaps in `None` when STT is disabled or the model is missing.

get.description:
Returns `200 OK` with the status when the engine is running.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when the engine is absent.

post.description:
Accepts `multipart/form-data` with:
- `audio` (required): WAV audio file
- `language` (optional): language hint (ISO 639-1 code)

Returns `200 OK` with the persisted transcript row (`TranscriptRow`).
Returns `400 Bad Request` on missing or invalid audio.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when the engine is absent.

requestBody.description: Multipart form with an `audio` WAV field (required) and an optional `language` hint

get.description:
Supports `?limit=N&offset=N` query parameters for pagination.
Returns `200 OK` with the list, even when empty.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when the STT subsystem is absent.

delete.description:
Returns `204 No Content` on success (even if the ID did not exist).
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when the STT subsystem is absent.

get.description:
Returns all known tasks with their agent and status.
Supports an optional `?status=<value>` query parameter to filter results.

post.description:
Submits a new task to the specified agent via the TaskRouter.
Returns 202 Accepted with the generated task_id on success.

get.description: Returns the current status of a task. Returns 404 if the task does not exist.

delete.description: Cancels a running task. Returns 404 if the task does not exist.

post.description:
Resolves the plan gate registered for the run, unblocking the engine that
paused after plan generation. The path id is the run identifier (the task
id on the orchestrated path).

## HTTP codes
- `200 OK`, decision recorded and the gate resolved
- `400 Bad Request`, unknown `decision` value
- `404 Not Found`, no gate pending for this run (unknown, resolved, expired)
- `503 Service Unavailable`, the plan gate is not configured

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id (task id on the orchestrated path)

post.description:
Validates that the task is in `input_required` status, persists the human
decision to SQLite, emits `RuntimeEvent::TaskResumed` on the EventBus,
and rebuilds the enriched `AIPTask` for the ORIA relaunch.

## HTTP codes
- `200 OK`, resume recorded successfully
- `404 Not Found`, task unknown to the HITL system
- `409 Conflict`, task known but not in `input_required` status
- `503 Service Unavailable`, HITL not configured (`task_repository` absent)
- `500 Internal Server Error`, SQLite or internal error

Starts an `apollia-review` task for the given task ID, waits synchronously
for completion (up to 120 s), then parses and returns the [`ReviewReport`].

500.description: Review agent failed or output unavailable

get.description:
Returns all A2A delegations recorded for the parent task.
Returns 404 if no delegation is found for this `task_id`.
Returns 503 if the sidechain logger is not initialized.

Subscribes to the runtime EventBus and streams task-specific events via SSE.
Returns 404 if the task does not exist in the TaskRouter.
The stream closes after a terminal event (completed/failed/canceled).
Client disconnection drops the subscriber automatically (no leak).

Aggregates data from 5 SQLite sources (hitl.db, plans.db, llm.db, audit.db)
into a unified timeline sorted by timestamp ascending. Returns 404 when the
task is unknown to all sources.

200: `TraceResponse` (may be empty if the task has not yet produced any
persisted event).
500: error opening the database or running the query.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Pagination cursor: events strictly after this UUIDv7 event_id

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (clamped to 5000)

get.description:
Returns `200 OK` with the list, even when empty.
Returns `503` if the tool registry is not available in the current runtime context.
Returns `500` if the registry actor has terminated unexpectedly.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/tools/:name`, return the descriptor for a specific tool.
get.description:
Returns `200 OK` with the descriptor, `404 Not Found` if the tool is not registered,
`503` if the tool registry is not available, or `500` on actor error.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/triggers`, list all triggers with their status.

post.description:
Validates the definition, inserts it into `triggers.db`, reloads the engine,
and returns `201` with the full definition (including `created_at`).

Re-reads definitions from the SQLite repository (no longer TOML),
converts them to rich types, and reloads the `TriggerEngine`.
Emits `TriggersReloaded` on the EventBus via the engine.

put.description:
Validates the new definition, updates it in `triggers.db`,
reloads the engine, and returns `200` with the updated definition.

delete.description: Removes it from `triggers.db`, reloads the engine, and returns `200`.

get.description: The `?last=N` query parameter controls the number of entries (default: 20).

post.description:
Verifies the request HMAC-SHA256 signature before forwarding the event to
the [`TriggerEngineHandle`]. Returns 503 if the TriggerEngine is not started,
404 if the trigger is unknown, 401 if the signature is absent or invalid, 200 otherwise.

requestBody.description: Raw webhook payload, verified against the `X-Apollia-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 header

A2AInvocationResult.description: Result of a successful A2A invocation.

agent_name.description: Name of the Worker Agent that handled the invocation.

result.description: AIP result returned by the Worker Agent.

A2aAgentDto.description: Entry in the A2A agent list.

name.description: Agent name as declared in its manifest.

agents.description: Active A2A agents with their skills.

A2aDelegateResult.description: Result of a successful A2A delegation.

agent_name.description: Name of the Worker Agent that handled the delegation.

output.description: Text output produced by the Worker Agent.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task executed by the Worker Agent.

A2aSkillDto.description: Skill declared by an A2A agent.

description.description: Description of what the skill does.

skills.description: Flat list of all available A2A skills.

AgentMessageDto.description: DTO for a single agent message.

messages.description: Messages sorted by `sent_at` descending (most recent first).

skills.description: Skills declared by this agent (populated in list and detail responses).

supports_a2a.description: Whether this agent supports A2A inter-agent communication.

ApiErrorBody.description:
Canonical error body for every non-2xx response in the spec.

Matches the wire shape of the per-module `ErrorResponse { error }` used
across the route handlers.

AuditEventResponse.description: A single audit event as returned by the API.

run_id.description:
Stable run identifier this invocation belongs to (the key `audit verify`
uses). `null` for invocations recorded before run_id tracking (kept in the
payload unconditionally so the schema is stable for automation).

stderr.description: Error output of the tool, possibly truncated.

stdout.description: Standard output of the tool, possibly truncated.

count.description: Number of entries in this page.

entries.description: Journal entries, newest global position first.

Ordered journal entries (tool calls AND LLM completions), so the model's
captured reasoning is readable, not only verifiable/replayable.

run_id.description: The run whose journal entries these are.

message_id.description: ID of the message that triggered the tool call.

reason.description:
Free-form rejection reason shared with the agent. Only honoured when
`decision == "refuse"`.

scope.description:
Always-accept scope. Only honoured when `decision == "always_accept"`.
Defaults to [`crate::chat::AlwaysAcceptScope::ThisSession`].

tool_call_id.description:
Unique id of the tool call being resolved. Correlates with the
`approval_required` event so the same tool invoked twice in one turn
resolves the right pending slot. Defaults to the tool name for legacy
clients that do not yet send it.

BrokenLink.description: The first broken link found while walking a chain.

reason.description: Why the link is considered broken.

seq.description: Sequence number of the offending entry.

BrokenLinkReason.description: Reason a chain link failed verification.

ChannelResponse.description: Full notification channel returned by the CRUD operations.

label.description: Free-form display name. `null` falls back to `id` in the UI.

backend.description: Backend to use; falls back to the router default if omitted.

prompt.description: User prompt text to send to the LLM.

backend.description: Name of the backend that served this request (for transparency).

usage.description: Token usage statistics for this call.

backend.description: Backend to use; falls back to the router default if omitted.

grammar.description: Optional GBNF grammar constraining the decoding (local backends).

messages.description: Ordered list of messages forming the conversation history.

CostSummaryRow.description: A single backend/model cost summary row.

events.description: Channel-specific event list. `null` uses the global events.

label.description: Free-form display name. `None` falls back to `id` in the UI.

min_interval_seconds.description: Minimum throttling interval, in seconds. Default: `0` (none).

config_json.description: Provider-specific configuration object (must be a JSON object, not null or primitive).

is_default.description: Mark this backend as the default (default: `false`).

project_id.description: Project to link this session to.

tools.description: List of tool names available in this session.

on_busy.description: Policy when the agent is busy (default: `"queue"`).

DailyCostEntry.description: A single day+backend cost entry for the daily chart.

cost_usd.description: Total estimated cost in USD for this day.

date.description: Local calendar day of the host, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

input.description: JSON payload passed to the Worker Agent as input.

up_to_index.description: Number of messages to copy from the parent (None = all).

HealthResponse.description: Response body for the health endpoint.

from.description:
Optional host identifier; the sender is recorded as `host:<id>` (or
`host` when absent), so injected traffic is distinguishable in the audit.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON payload to deliver to the agent's inbox.

InjectMessageResponse.description: Response body for a successful injection.

message_id.description: Identifier assigned to the injected message.

caller.description: Caller name (Director Agent), used for observability.

input.description: JSON payload passed to the Worker Agent as input.

JournalAnchor.description:
The exportable head anchor of the global chain.

Printing and storing this off-machine is the only defense against truncation
of the global tail once the signing key can be compromised.

global_hash.description: Global hash at that position: the head of the chain.

key_id.description: Signing key id in force, when the journal is signed.

updated_ts.description: When the anchor was last advanced (RFC3339).

JournalBreak.description: The first broken link found while walking the global chain.

global_seq.description: Global sequence number of the offending entry.

reason.description: Why the link is considered broken.

run_id.description: Run the offending entry belongs to.

JournalBreakReason.description: Reason a global-chain link failed whole-journal verification.

LlmBackendResponse.description: Response body for a single backend.

is_default.description: Whether this is the default backend.

backends.description: All configured LLM backends with their current availability state.

ceiling_reached.description:
Whether the cost ceiling has been reached. Always `false` when hybrid
routing is not configured.

ceiling_usd.description:
Hybrid routing cost ceiling in USD. `None` when hybrid routing is not
configured.

cost_usd.description: Accumulated session cost in USD. `None` when no router is configured.

MessageDto.description:
A single message in a multi-turn conversation request.

`role` accepts `"system"`, `"user"`, `"assistant"`, or `"tool"`.

ModelInfo.description: Description of a model file on disk.

backend.description: Backend name to ping; uses the router default if `null` or omitted.
Name of the backend that was pinged.

latency_ms.description: Round-trip latency in milliseconds (only set when `available` is `true`).

cache_hits.description: Total number of cache hits across all entries.

newest_entry_at.description: Timestamp of the newest cache entry, or `null`.

oldest_entry_at.description: Timestamp of the oldest cache entry, or `null`.

PlanDecisionRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/plan-decision`.

The operator approves the generated plan or rejects it with optional
feedback used to guide replanning.

decision.description: `"approved"` to execute the plan, `"rejected"` to replan.

feedback.description: Optional feedback injected into the next planning attempt on rejection.

run_id.description: Run identifier whose gate was resolved.

reloaded.description: Number of active triggers after reload.

ReloadRouterResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/llm/reload`.

Carries the list of backends that are live in the freshly-swapped router,
so callers can confirm at a glance what is now available without a
follow-up `GET /api/v1/llm/status` call.

backends.description: Backends now reachable via the active router.

default.description: Default backend name reported by the router (empty when no backends).

reaches_running_agents.description:
Whether the rebuilt router reaches agents that are already running.

`false` today, and not a transient state: the agent execution path reads
its router from a `OnceLock` populated at boot, a different cell from the
one this route rewrites. A reload therefore reaches chat and this API,
and an already-running agent keeps the router it started with until the
daemon restarts. Reported rather than hidden, because the failure it
produces on the Python side, `'NoneType' object has no attribute
'complete'`, names none of this.

ResetResponse.description: Response body for the reset route.

circuit_breakers.description: Snapshot for every tool the runtime has seen at least one event for.

ResumeRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/resume`.

The operator submits a decision (`approved`) and an optional reason.
The `approved` field is mandatory; omitting it produces HTTP 422.

reason.description: Reason for the decision, optional, mainly useful when rejecting.

ResumeResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/resume`.

Returned with HTTP 200 when the resume is recorded successfully.

status.description: New task status (`"working"` after approval or rejection).

content.description: Text content of the user message.

default.description: The backend that is now the default.

ShutdownResponse.description: Response body for the shutdown endpoint.

agent_name.description: Target agent name (or the skill_id used for resolution).

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the delegation finished (`None` if still running).

output_summary.description: First 500 characters of the output or the error message.

sidechain_n.description: Sequential delegation number for this parent (1-based).

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the delegation started.

SkillDto.description: Abridged skill descriptor included in the agent list response.

SkillListing.description:
Entry in the list of available skills.

Returned by [`A2AInvoker::list_skills`] and used by `ctx.a2a_list_skills()`.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent that provides this skill.

input_schema.description:
Apollia schema for the payload fields (cf. `AgentSkill::input_schema`).
Used by `generate_a2a_tool_specs` to expose the worker's real contract
to the LLM (instead of a generic schema).

allOf.description: Event fields (flattened into the top-level JSON object).

SseMailboxEvent.description: SSE frame emitted by the mailbox observation stream.

allOf.description: Additional event data (flattened into the top-level JSON object).

SseTaskEvent.description:
SSE event sent to the client.

Serialized as a flat JSON object with an `event` field discriminating
the event type and additional data fields depending on the variant.

agent_path.description: Path to the agent Python module.

loaded.description:
Whether an engine is loaded after the reload. `false` when STT is
disabled, the model file is absent, or the runner is unavailable.

cuda_enabled.description: `true` when compiled with NVIDIA CUDA GPU acceleration.

enabled.description: Whether STT is enabled in configuration.

metal_enabled.description: `true` when compiled with Apple Metal GPU acceleration.

model_loaded.description: Whether the model is loaded and ready for inference.

model_name.description: Short model name (derived from filename without extension).

model_path.description: Filesystem path of the loaded model.

input.description: Free-form JSON input for the task.

TaskListItem.description: One entry in the task list.

error.description:
Failure reason for a failed task (parity with `task status`); `null`
otherwise. Kept unconditionally so the schema is stable for automation.

error_code.description: Structured failure code parsed from the error (e.g. `BAD_MESSAGE`).

tasks.description: All tasks matching the optional filter.

error_code.description:
Structured failure code parsed from the error (e.g. `BAD_MESSAGE`), so
automation can branch on the code without string-matching the message.

run_id.description:
Stable run identifier this task belongs to, used by `audit verify`.
Kept unconditionally so the schema is stable for automation.

token_budget.description: Token budget accumulated over all LLM calls for this task.

TestLiveRequest.description:
Body for [`test_live_server`]: the optional read-only probe to run against
the live session, supplied by the desktop from the connector enrichment.

probe.description: Read-only probe declared for this connector, when any.

oneOf.description: Task state transition (submitted -> running -> completed, etc.).
Start of an ORIA step (orchestrated mode).

output_preview.description: Output preview (stdout + stderr), truncated to 500 chars.

oneOf.description: HITL suspension: the agent requests human approval.
HITL resolution: the operator has responded.

TimelineEvent.description:
A single event in a task's execution timeline.

Each variant maps to a kind of action recorded during execution. The JSON
`type` tag uses `snake_case`.

items.description: Current todo items, ordered by insertion.

session_id.description: Session whose todo list is returned.

TokenUsageResponse.description: Token usage included in chat responses.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the completion.

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD (cloud backends only; `None` for local inference).

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

tools.description: All descriptors currently registered in the tool catalogue.

next_cursor.description:
Cursor to pass as `?since=` on the next call to fetch the rest.

TriggerDefinitionResponse.description: Response for CRUD operations returning a full definition.

on_busy.description: Policy when the agent is busy.

VerifyChainReport.description: Outcome of verifying a run's chain.

entries_checked.description: Number of entries inspected (all of them when `ok`).

VerifyJournalReport.description: Outcome of verifying the whole journal across all runs.

oneOf.description: The first broken link, or `None` when the chain is intact.

head_matches_state.description:
Whether the terminal global head matches the persisted state anchor. A
`false` here with no `first_break` signals global-tail truncation or a
rolled-back state row (detectable in-database only until the key is
